newsitem.title: USA: Nationsbank says proceeds to be used for general purposes.
newsitem.headline: Nationsbank says proceeds to be used for general purposes.

text.p: NationsBank Corp said on Wednesday it filed a $3 billion shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer debt and equity securities.

Proceeds from any future issuance of new securities would be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital needs, the funding of the banking and non-banking subsidiaries, the payment of maturing debt and other activities, NationsBank said.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said it will also use the net proceeds for possible acquisitions of other financial institutions or their assets or liabilities.

Proceeds may also be used for possible acquisitions of or investments in other businesses of a type eligible for bank holding companies and the repurchase of outstanding equity securities of the corporation, the filing said.
